get.description: Finds MQTT clients in HiveMQ Cloud by query parameters.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: booleanFilter
parameters.description: Boolean client search filter in the documented type:value format, for example CONNECTED:true.

schema.description: Boolean client search filter in the documented type:value format, for example CONNECTED:true.

parameters.name: stringFilter
parameters.description: String client search filter in the documented type:operation:value format, for example ID:EQ:client1.

schema.description: String client search filter in the documented type:operation:value format, for example ID:EQ:client1.

parameters.name: numberFilter
parameters.description: Number client search filter in the documented type:operation:value format, for example MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:GT:100.

schema.description: Number client search filter in the documented type:operation:value format, for example MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:GT:100.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size between 50 and 2500. HiveMQ documents 500 as the default.

schema.description: Page size between 50 and 2500. HiveMQ documents 500 as the default.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor returned by the previous search page.

schema.description: Cursor returned by the previous search page.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
